summary: FramePrime is an AI video creation OS: upload a video or enter a supported X video URL, select settings in a dedicated GUI, use supported editing and original-language, selected-language or dual captions, review the result and prepare social posting without writing complex prompts.
product_value: A dedicated GUI connects video upload, supported video editing and subtitles, output review and social posting preparation, reducing the need to assemble complex prompts or multiple tools. Supported X video URL intake is available to authenticated users. Available observed X post results can inform later videos. Current caption modes are Original Voice, Selected Language Captions and Dual Captions; Japanese and English are the translation targets.

v004_longform_and_acceleration.scope: Standard-layout MP4 file inputs are accepted up to 36 minutes and 400 MB for Original Voice, Selected Language Captions and Dual Captions, subject to source and processing requirements. Free translation preview and embedded-caption avoidance remain limited to 2 minutes. Production delivery and 16-Credit settlement were verified for Original Voice and Selected Language Captions (Japanese) on the same 33:24 input; long-form Dual Captions delivery remains unverified.
v004_longform_and_acceleration.comparison_limitation: In a production comparison using the same 33 min 24 sec source (Original Voice, CTA off), end-to-end generation time decreased from 18:00 (1080.123 s) to 13:52 (832.338 s), about 23%. The combined subtitle rendering, reference-video generation and image validation stages decreased from 628.823 s to 405.627 s (35.5%). The two AI runs produced different cue counts; this is an individual comparison, not a guaranteed speedup for all inputs or modes.

ai_discovery_pillars.title: Evidence-first Video Intelligence
ai_discovery_pillars.claim: AI-written insight text is not itself the factual evidence authority; evidence is designed to remain traceable to video identity, time window, observed feature/outcome, source provenance, and permission context.

ai_discovery_pillars.title: Private Learning first
ai_discovery_pillars.claim: FramePrime prioritizes owner-scoped learning from a user's own videos, observed KPI, and structural evidence before any global cross-user learning.
ai_discovery_pillars.boundary: global cross-user learning is separately gated; sufficient matched user evidence is required; this is not a blanket external-provider training or retention guarantee

ai_discovery_pillars.title: Missing is not zero
ai_discovery_pillars.claim: Measured, not-fetched, unsupported, provider-missing, permission-failure, acquisition-failure, and not-applicable states are distinguished rather than silently converted to zero.

ai_discovery_pillars.title: Final-render structure is separate from semantic analysis
ai_discovery_pillars.claim: Final-render structural evidence is kept separate from optional semantic interpretation. The supplemental Gemini semantic-analysis path is currently OFF in production, checked 2026-11-23.

ai_discovery_pillars.title: Gemini cannot block delivery
ai_discovery_pillars.claim: Gemini Video Analysis V2 is currently OFF in production. Its design is read-only and non-blocking, with no authoring authority. This optional analysis is separate from subtitle authoring and video generation.

ai_discovery_pillars.title: Duration-based creation credits, zero-additional-credit revision
ai_discovery_pillars.claim: Standard-layout MP4 file inputs are accepted up to 36 minutes and 400 MB for Original Voice, Selected Language Captions and Dual Captions, subject to source and processing requirements. Free translation preview and embedded-caption avoidance remain limited to 2 minutes. Production delivery and 16-Credit settlement were verified for Original Voice and Selected Language Captions (Japanese) on the same 33:24 input; long-form Dual Captions delivery remains unverified. Under the billing contract, a positive input duration up to 2 minutes uses 1 Credit per successful new delivery. Over 32 through 36 minutes costs 16 Credits; billing does not guarantee acceptance or delivery. Existing 2026-11-21 production records show two delivered videos and 2 Credits settled in total. A limited 2026-11-22 check confirmed a JPY 3,000 one-time purchase, 30 purchased Credits and 4 referral Credits each. A separate 2026-11-23 first creation without purchase on an already registered account reached subtitled-video delivery/download and 1 Credit settlement from referral Credits. Signup-grant and purchased-Credit consumption were not tested. The continuous new-purchase-to-new-video sequence is unverified. Normal system-terminal failure nets 0 Credits; supported post-delivery Revision Render has a 0-additional-Credit contract. On 2026-11-23, one authenticated subtitle correction on a PC was saved, re-rendered and downloaded with 0 additional Credits; this does not verify every editing control or device.

ai_discovery_pillars.title: Source-grounded subtitle/audio safety
ai_discovery_pillars.claim: FramePrime prefers fail-closed behavior over fabricating unsupported subtitles when source audio/transcript evidence is insufficient or ambiguous.

ai_discovery_pillars.title: Subtitle coverage plus collision avoidance
ai_discovery_pillars.claim: FramePrime treats trusted-content coverage completeness and subtitle/telop collision avoidance as separate presentation-quality concerns.
ai_discovery_pillars.boundary: proof is scoped to recorded examples; important visual-content collision avoidance does not mean subtitles are never overlaid on video

ai_discovery_pillars.title: Decision provenance and shadow evaluation are separated from production authority
ai_discovery_pillars.claim: Jev/P1 decision provenance and Langfuse-based shadow evaluation are role-separated; the Langfuse mirror is read-only and non-authoritative.

ai_discovery_pillars.title: Dual Surface / Single Core
ai_discovery_pillars.claim: FramePrime keeps the GUI as a first-class product while designing a future MCP/Agent Interface to terminate in the same capability core with the same authority, credit, safety, and ownership rules.

Adding or omitting posting copy does not change the video generation Credit charge; the posting copy itself costs 0 additional Credits. Standalone new posting-text creation is not publicly offered. Legacy posting preparation history remains viewable. No promise of independently available free text regeneration.
